source_md:
Setting up and launching your online course might seem daunting at first, but trust me—it's simpler than you think! With just a few clicks, you'll be on your way to sharing your expertise, building your audience, and even earning some income. Let's dive in step-by-step.

In this guide, you'll learn how to:

- Create a course
- Build and organize course content
- Create an offer
- Configure pricing
- Publish and test your course
- Share your course with learners

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Overview](#Overview)
- [Before You Begin](#Before-You-Begin)
- [Create a Course](#Create-a-Course)
- [Build Your Course Content](#Build-Your-Course-Content)
- [Create an Offer](#Create-an-Offer)
- [Sell Offer](#Sell-Offer)
- [Publish & Share Your Offer](#Publish-&-Share-Your-Offer)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **Overview**

HighLevel Courses help you create, organize, and sell online learning experiences. Whether you're offering free training or paid programs, launching a course involves more than just creating content—you'll also need to create an offer, configure pricing, and test the learner experience before sharing it with your audience.

## **Before You Begin**

Before launching your course, make sure you have:

- Access to **Memberships → Courses**
- Your course content (videos, lessons, PDFs, quizzes, etc.)
- A course thumbnail (optional but recommended)
- A connected payment provider if you're selling a paid course
- A clear pricing model (Free, One-Time, or Recurring)

> **Tip:** If you're creating a paid course, verify that your payment provider is connected before creating your offer.

---

## **Create a Course**

Creating your first course is like laying the foundation for your teaching empire. It’s exciting and easy—let's walk through it together.

1. Navigate to Memberships > Courses > Products.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067626946/original/xC3XQuB72es3s71pE5_EkekhCU_5B8GUBA.png?1774365062)
2. Click **Create Product > Start from Scratch**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067627035/original/0m0VAHfAtZ1yOMkn-G-ryxllZWGO3pkRTg.png?1774365119)
3. Add your course details, including the **Course Title** and **Course Description**. Upload a thumbnail image for your course. Set the pricing for your course by selecting **Free**, **Recurring**, or **One Time**, then click **Create Course**.  
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067627958/original/ney-1Jg2J9jHWNLg4TvbRYC4p9mSNgh7qg.gif?1774365612)
4. Build out your course content from scratch or edit the template.  
     
   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067628139/original/F5AQ6NHbZOYBHs2Q5-38Z9QBNHb1yAr6SA.png?1774365669)**

### **Use the course editor (New Layout)**

 

After you create the course, HighLevel opens the course editor in a large workspace so you can build content faster.

 

**What You Will See:**

 

- A left panel that shows your course structure (modules, lessons, quizzes, and assignments).
- A main editor area for the item you selected.
- Breadcrumbs at the top so you always know where you are in the course.

 

**Common Actions:**

 

- Select any lesson or quiz in the left panel to open it in the editor.
- Drag and drop items in the left panel to reorder content.
- Expand or collapse modules to focus on one section at a time.

```
Note: UI labels and button names may vary by account rollout.
```

  

**Next step:** Explore more ways to enhance your course:

- [How To Build Courses / Membership Sites](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001141015-how-to-build-courses-membership-sites)
- [Paid Courses inside Communities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002135-paid-courses-inside-communities)
- [Advanced Course Unlock Options in Communities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004656-advanced-course-unlock-options-in-communities)

---

## **Build Your Course Content**

Once your course has been created, begin adding your learning content.

Use the Course Editor to:

- Create modules or sections
- Add lessons
- Upload videos or downloadable files
- Organize content in the desired order
- Save your changes

> **Note:** Your course contains the learning content that students will access after enrollment.

---

## **Create an Offer**

Once your amazing course is ready, creating an offer is like packaging a beautiful gift—enticing and clearly valuable. Here's how to make it irresistible:

1. Navigate to **Memberships > Courses > Offers**.
2. Click **Create Offer**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067628519/original/Kx1BZHkYB3OqEJDLuLu8u13Kq8eZ9j0WtQ.png?1774365815)
3. Fill in your offer details to clearly communicate the value.
4. Assign your newly created course product to the offer.
5. Set your desired price.
6. Click **Create**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067628657/original/T-DMPbjLV2AYbk5t1MpW5Jw_Lu7REW2A-w.png?1774365873)
7. Switch your Offer from Draft to Published and click Save.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067628755/original/m6DDCoJacz7MrnvPcWolZK5RpmFFuljIFg.png?1774365931)
8. Or switch between draft and published directly in the offers list.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067628836/original/xFFnpkpY7jgpQllHmDVWs_wGpTwyRybWIQ.png?1774365968)

**Next you can:** Consider bundling offers or creating discount codes to attract more learners.

---

## **Sell Offer**

Congratulations, your offer is ready to share with the world! The final step is all about connecting with your audience. Let’s quickly generate and share your offer:

1. Navigate back to **Memberships > Courses > Offers**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067629244/original/EuqFUSfzAvN1Oafi3BMQcIIpiTHWqqeKpA.png?1774366145)
2. Click the **link** icon to get the link for an offer.
3. Click **Copy**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067629363/original/IMZnc01t0Hj7BS4bB5u_Q0wlIMLNW6Jwyg.png?1774366186)
4. Share it across your channels—social media, emails, or your website.

**Next you can:** Explore marketing strategies or launch a campaign to boost your course sales.

---

## **Publish & Share Your Offer**

Once your offer has been configured:

- Review the pricing details.
- Confirm the correct course is attached.
- Publish the offer.
- Copy the offer link.

Your offer link can be shared through:

- Email campaigns
- Landing pages
- Websites
- Social media
- Direct messages

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q. Why isn't my course visible?**

If you can't find your course:

- Confirm the course was created successfully.
- Verify you're working in the correct sub-account.
- Refresh the Courses page to ensure you're viewing the latest changes.

**Q. Why isn't my offer available?**

If your offer isn't appearing:

- Verify the offer has been published.
- Confirm the correct course is attached to the offer.
- Review your offer configuration to ensure it has been saved successfully.

**Q. Why can't customers purchase my course?**

If learners can't complete a purchase:

- Verify that a supported payment provider is connected to your account.
- Review your offer pricing and payment configuration.
- Confirm the offer is published and available for purchase.

**Q. Why can't a learner access my course?**

If a learner has purchased or enrolled but can't access the course:

- Confirm the learner successfully completed enrollment.
- Verify the correct course is associated with the offer.
- If you're granting access through workflows, review the workflow configuration to ensure it is active and functioning as expected.

**Q. Why aren't my videos or files loading?**

If course media isn't loading correctly:

- Refresh the page and confirm the upload completed successfully.
- Verify that the lesson contains the correct media file.
- If the issue persists, try uploading the file again and ensure it is supported by the Course Editor.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Learning Tab (Courses)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001238)
- [Paid Courses inside Communities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002135)
- [How to Grant Access to Membership Courses Using Workflows](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002845)

title_en: Company Object Feature: A Manual Way to Organize Contacts
source_md:
The Company Object feature in HighLevel helps users group related contacts under a shared company profile. This enhances relationship management, contact organization, and activity tracking across teams working with the same client business.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Company Object Feature?](#What-is-the-Company-Object-Feature?)
- [Key Benefits of the Company Object Feature](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Company-Object-Feature)
- [How to Create the Company Object](#How-to-Create-the-Company-Object)
  - [Step 1: Navigate to the Companies Section:](#Step-1%3A%C2%A0Navigate-to-the-Companies-Section%3A)
  - [Step 2: Add a New Company](#Step-2%3A-Add-a-New-Company)
  - [Step 3: Enter Company Details](#Step-3%3A%C2%A0Enter-Company-Details)
- [How to Edit or Update Company Details](#How-to-Edit-or-Update-Company-Details)
- [How to Delete a Company](#How-to-Delete-a-Company)
- [How to Add Contacts to a Company](#How-to-Add-Contacts-to-a-Company)
- [How to Remove a Contact from a Company](#How-to-Remove-a-Contact-from-a-Company)
- [Automate Contact-to-Company Assignment](#Automate-Contact-to-Company-Assignment)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Company Object Feature?**

The Company Object allows you to associate multiple contacts with a single company entity, making it easier to manage client relationships at the organizational level. This is particularly useful when your team interacts with various people from the same business. By grouping them under one record, you can view collective engagement, centralize data, and improve communication across touch points.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Company Object Feature**

Using the Company Object provides practical advantages for managing contact relationships:

- **Organized Contact Management:** Easily group multiple contacts under one company.
- **Consolidated Activity Tracking:** Monitor interactions and activities related to a company.
- **Enhanced Relationship Insights:** Gain a complete view of how your team engages with an organization.
- **Efficient Communication:**Easily communicate with all contacts linked to a company.
- **Improved Data Accuracy:** Maintain consistent and updated information across company-associated contacts.

---

## **How to Create the Company Object**

Follow these steps to set up a new company in HighLevel:

### **Step 1:**Navigate to the Companies Section:

- Use the main navigation bar on the left to navigate to **Contacts**
- Navigate to the tab labeled **Companies** in the secondary navigation ribbon at the top of the page

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041969865/original/afPxEFXXuOBxnAqTaV3LFBqNvqJ_8oglww.png?1740065034)

### **Step 2:** Add a New Company

- Click on the blue button at the top right labeled **+ New Company**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041969989/original/h0xP2Ge9B26gWwWxU6549DHsoSBCwKFHVA.png?1740065114)

### **Step 3:**Enter Company Details

Enter the company details in the box on the right of the screen. Below are the details you are able to add:

- **Company Name** (mandatory)
- **Phone Number**
- **Email**
- **Website**
- **Description**
- **Address Details** (Street, City, Postal Code, Country)

```
Please Note: Only the company name is required, but adding more details enhances usability.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041970367/original/LbLWS8aCQVKZDC4wUpWeqzJFaU4RmCQzJg.gif?1740065352)

---

## **How to Edit or Update Company Details**

1. **Go to the Company List**

   - Use the main navigation bar to Navigate to `Contacts`
   - Select the `Companies tab in the top navigation bar`
   - Click the **three dots (`...`)** next to the company you would like to edit and choose `Edit Company`
2. **Update Details**

   - Modify any necessary fields.
3. **Save Changes**

   - Click `Save` to apply the updates.

---

## **How to Delete a Company**

1. **Go to the Company List**

   - Use the main navigation bar to Navigate to `Contacts`
   - Select the `Companies tab in the top navigation bar`
2. **Select the Company to Delete**

   - Click the **three dots (`...`)** next to the company you would like to edit and choose `Delete Company`
3. **Confirm Deletion**

   - Click `Yes` to confirm.

```
Note: Deleting a company clears the Company field in associated contacts but does not delete the contacts themselves.
```

---

## **How to Add Contacts to a Company**

1. **Navigate to the Contact's Profile**

   - Use the main navigation bar to Navigate to `Contacts`
   - `Find the Contact you would like to add to the company and click on the contact's name`
2. **Assign the Company**:

   - Select the `Company`**tab** in the secondary navigation bar on the left of the page
   - Search for and select the company.
3. **Save Changes**

   - Click `Save` to update the contact's association.

```
For bulk assignment, select multiple contacts and assign them to a company at once.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155045226266/original/hB0MXzNuW4JiT_N6tcQE2IUWCEYF2s689Q.jpeg?1744827285)

---

## **How to Remove a Contact from a Company**

1. **Access the Company Profile**

   - Use the main navigation bar to Navigate to `Contacts`
   - Select the `Companies tab in the top navigation bar`
   - Select the company.
2. **View Associated Contacts**

   - Navigate to the `Contacts` tab.
3. **Remove the Contact**

   - Click the **Trash Bin** icon next to the contact.
4. **Confirm Removal**

   - Click `Yes` to finalize.

*Note: Removing a contact from a company does not delete the contact; it only removes the association.*

```
Automating Company Associations: HighLevel provides automation features to streamline company assignments. Please refer to Company Object Automation
```

---

## **Automate Contact-to-Company Assignment**

You can automate this process based on the "Business Name" field in contacts.  
  
To enable:

- Go to **Settings > Objects > Company**
- Toggle **Automatically Create and Associate Companies from Contact Business Names**

```
Learn more in the article: Company Object Automation
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I assign multiple companies to a single contact?**  
No, a contact can only be associated with one company at a time.

**Q: Will deleting a company removes all its contacts?**  
No, it only removes the company association. Contacts remain in your database.

**Q: Can I bulk assign contacts to a company?**  
Yes, select multiple contacts in the contact list and assign them to a company at once.

**Q: How do I find all contacts linked to a specific company?**  
Navigate to Contacts > Companies, select the company, and view the Contacts tab.

**Q: Can I automate contact-company associations without manually assigning them?**  
Yes, enable Automatically Create and Associate Companies from Contact Business Names in Settings > Objects > Company.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Company Object Automation](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001228591)
- [Getting Started with Custom Objects](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003896-getting-started-with-custom-objects?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Importing Contacts and Opportunities via CSV](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003905)
- [Associations for Custom Objects](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004033)
- [Workflow Action - Create Contact](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002685)

Web Chat inside Conversations allows businesses to communicate with website visitors in real time through a website chat widget. Messages sent from the widget appear directly in the Conversations inbox, where teams can manage them alongside SMS, email, and other communication channels.

This article explains how Web Chat works, how to configure the chat widget, and how to manage Web Chat conversations inside Conversations.

> **Important:** Web Chat is distinct from Live Chat. Channel labels are now consistent across the platform to clearly differentiate the two experiences.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [How Web Chat Works](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BHow-Web-Chat-Works)
- [Setting Up Web Chat](#Setting-Up-Web-Chat)
- [Managing Web Chat Conversations](#Managing-Web-Chat-Conversations)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles%E2%80%8B)

---

# **How Web Chat Works**

Web Chat enables visitors on your website to start a conversation instantly. When a visitor sends a message through the chat widget, the message is routed directly to the Conversations inbox in your sub-account.

Inside Conversations, Web Chat messages appear in real time. Agents can open the thread, respond immediately, assign the conversation, or manage it just like any other channel.

Web Chat centralizes website conversations so teams do not need to switch between platforms.

---

## **Setting Up Web Chat**

To enable Web Chat, you must create and configure a chat widget.

Navigate to **Sites → Chat Widget** and click **+ New** to create a widget.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064712895/original/YYkwwOk7UdKbICVBGF7Bi966rwqh1rMOTA.png?1770826807)  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064713569/original/FxlWfSBKlVY305W8RQ9nPQJEc-ITSM1Jjw.png?1770827200)

When selecting the chat type, choose **Live chat**. Although the setup screen displays “Live chat,” this option configures the Web Chat channel that routes website messages into Conversations.

After selecting the chat type, customize the widget settings according to your needs.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064713593/original/OC_HIOJgXVHQfE8HqK9tfrSU1lMGHmru3Q.png?1770827226)

You can configure:

- Intro message
- Agent avatar and branding
- Inactivity fallback message
- Chat timeout message

Once configured, save the widget and install it on your website by copying the provided script into your website’s footer or body section. If you are using WordPress, install the **LeadConnector plugin** to enable the widget.

After installation, visitors can begin sending Web Chat messages from your website.

---

## **Managing Web Chat Conversations**

When a visitor sends a message, it appears instantly inside **Conversations**.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064713051/original/M9s2JNrW0_rpY2_OZcdoRPmYeArr7JCNBA.png?1770826888)

Web Chat conversations can be identified by the chat icon in the inbox. You can open the thread to respond in real time. Conversations can be assigned manually or automatically to team members using workflows or ownership rules.

To focus only on Web Chat messages, use the filter option inside Conversations.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064713123/original/LT60iImtWOgmPVqFgRHF9JM-KmgcemlLng.png?1770826906)

Under **Last Message Channel**, select **Live Chat** and apply the filter. This displays only Web Chat conversations originating from your website.

When a conversation is complete, you can use the **End Chat** option. Chats can also close automatically based on inactivity settings configured in the widget.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How do I ensure Web Chat messages appear in Conversations?**

Install and enable the chat widget and select **Live chat** under **Sites → Chat Widget**. Messages will automatically route to Conversations.

**Q: Why does the setup screen say “Live chat” if this is Web Chat?**

The widget setup currently uses the label “Live chat,” but it configures the Web Chat channel that routes website conversations into Conversations.

**Q: What happens if no one responds to a Web Chat message?**

If no agent responds within the configured inactivity time, the fallback message prompts the visitor to leave their contact details so follow-up can continue later.

**Q: Can Web Chat conversations be assigned to specific team members?**

Yes. Conversations can be assigned manually or automatically using workflows and assignment rules.

**Q: Can I filter only Web Chat conversations?**

Yes. Use the filter option in Conversations and select **Live Chat** under the message channel filter.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Conversation Views: Save Filters, Work Faster](https://help.leadconnectorhq.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007300)

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/1VEdxywhT1U?&wmode=opaque)

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Partial Payment?](#What-is-Partial-Payment?)
- [Impact of Partial Payment on Transactions & Orders](#Impact-of-Partial-Payment-on-Transactions-&-Orders)
- [How to Use Partial Payment?](#How-to-Use-Partial-Payment?)
- [How to collect the remaining balance?](#How-to-collect-the-remaining-balance?)
- [Key Benefits](#Key-Benefits)
- [FAQs](#FAQs)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles%C2%A0)

#### **What is Partial Payment?**

Partial payment offers bookers the opportunity to secure bookings by paying a deposit upfront, with the remaining balance settled at a later time. Alongside collecting full payments, businesses now have the capability to collect deposit amounts from bookers. This feature has been seamlessly implemented across all calendar types and aids in reserving seats.

With this new feature, users have the flexibility to determine either a flat amount or a percentage of the total amount to be charged to the booker at the time of booking.

---

#### **Impact of Partial Payment on Transactions & Orders**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155023874265/original/c5hsV31Rg8FUfyqrVrCgQQNFYMGoDAKZHA.png?1712122099)

When partial payments are enabled, two entries appear in payments:

- **Transaction:** The amount charged during booking (Deposit Amount).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155023874407/original/yKYCL_xx8aiCufzAFCIQifEpOMLWxqLDhQ.png?1712122324)

- **Orders**: The pending amount to be collected from the booker (Total Amount - Deposit Amount) and users are required to manually collect the pending amount.

---

#### **How to Use Partial Payment?**

**1. Integrate Payment Gateway:** Ensure that you have integrated a payment gateway such as Stripe or Authorize.net. (Payments Module > Integrations)

**2. Enable Payment:** Enable the "Accept Payments" toggle for the calendar from Calendar Settings > Forms & Payments section.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155023873723/original/qh84sI5jK74C15QtJDvFjkxIVY73lfCypw.png?1712120969)

**3. Enter Total Amount and Currency:** Specify the total amount for your service or appointment and select the desired currency.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155023875315/original/jDPTb95KbCiV_Z1bNFkGFXoBJAWYnoDQQg.png?1712123868)

4. **Activate Partial Payment Option:** Check the "Accept Partial Payment" box.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155023875330/original/nUChXVtlfLyUPYLTHT-bcLVTmTXbbghDqg.png?1712123912)

5. **Select Amount Type:** Choose whether to add a **Flat Amount or a percentage.** The percentage is calculated based on the total amount.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155023875412/original/EJ0SZ3ZGIUD92bWFq9JrXo90BjB_R_5vsA.png?1712123958)

6. **Enter Deposit Amount / Percentage:** Specify the deposit amount / deposit percentage for your service or appointment. The percentage is calculated based on the total amount entered.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155023875759/original/h6KWVxtgbVYQ-g0CLA4_P_43_NxR-nuE_w.png?1712124477)

7. **Add****Description:** Provide additional context by entering a description if needed.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155023874940/original/dkS82BeTBEBKpH74CNQ06h_tQXfNxLxUEQ.png?1712123347)

8. **Save Settings:** Click on save to apply the changes.

---

#### **How to collect the remaining balance?**

To collect the remaining payment, users must manually collect the payment against the appointment by opening the view appointment modal, navigating to the payments tab and clicking on **"Collect payment"**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084958604/original/IyeaFc193ycEBGNpM7PSFO5E_WUbV7Q4WQ.png?1793804835)

---

#### **Key Benefits**

This feature facilitates businesses in collecting deposit amounts, leading to a reduction in no-shows. By displaying the total cost of the appointment/service while offering the flexibility to pay only a deposit, businesses enhance the user experience without mandating upfront payments.

---

#### **FAQs**

Q: Which calendar type supports partial payments?

A: Partial payments can be enabled for all calendar types - Event, Round Robin, Collective, Class, Service Calendar and Service Menu.

Q: How do I manage pending payments?

A: Pending payments can be managed manually through the Payments tab while you view an appointment details. Users can view the pending amount and collect it from the booker accordingly.

Q: Which payment gateways are supported for calendar payments?

A: Currently, the supported payment gateways for calendar payments are Stripe, NMI and Authorize.net.

#### **Related Articles**

[Coupon Codes in Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006097)

This article shows you how to add **Prebuilt Mega Menu Headers** to your funnels or websites using HighLevel’s visual editor. Mega menus help structure your site’s navigation clearly and professionally—without the need for custom coding or complex setup.

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is a Prebuilt Mega Menu Header?](#What-is-a-Prebuilt-Mega-Menu-Header?)
- [Key Benefits of Prebuilt Mega Menu Headers](#Key-Benefits-of-Prebuilt-Mega-Menu-Headers)
- [How To Add a Prebuilt Mega Menu Header](#How-To-Add-a-Prebuilt-Mega-Menu-Header)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What is a Prebuilt Mega Menu Header?**

A Prebuilt Mega Menu Header is a ready-made navigation section that can be quickly added to any funnel or website page. These headers feature structured dropdown layouts that are ideal for websites with multiple categories, links, or service areas. They are fully customizable and help users find what they’re looking for more easily.

---

## **Key Benefits of Prebuilt Mega Menu Headers**

Adding a mega menu improves site usability and saves time by eliminating the need to build complex navigation from scratch.

    •    **Ready-to-Use Designs** – Choose from a range of prebuilt templates with professional layouts.

    •    **Streamlined User Experience** – Help visitors navigate large or complex websites more efficiently.

    •    **Fully Customizable Layouts** – Edit text, colors, spacing, icons, and link destinations to match your brand.

    •    **Quick Deployment** – Drag, drop, and publish—no technical expertise needed.

    •    **Consistent Look & Feel** – Maintain uniform navigation across pages for a cohesive site experience.

---

## **How To Add a Prebuilt Mega Menu Header**

Learn how to find and add a mega menu header to any funnel or website using the visual editor.

**Step-by-Step Instructions**

    1.    **Go to Sites**

From the left-hand menu in your HighLevel dashboard, click on **Sites**.

    2.    **Open the Funnel or Website Page**

Select the specific **funnel or website** where you want to add the mega menu, then open the page in the visual builder.

    3.    **Click “Add Elements”**

In the top-right corner of the visual editor, click the **“Add Elements”** button.

    4.    **Select “Prebuilt Sections”**

Scroll through the options and choose **“Prebuilt Sections”** from the sidebar menu.

    5.    **Choose a Mega Menu Design**

Browse the available mega menu layouts. Click to preview, then select the one that best fits your site’s structure.

    6.    **Customize the Menu**

Use the visual builder to:

    •    Edit link text and destinations

    •    Adjust colors, fonts, and spacing

    •    Add or remove icons and subcategories

    •    Rearrange columns or content blocks as needed

    7.    **Publish Your Page**

Once you’re satisfied with the layout and styling, click **Save** and **Publish** the page.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I use the same mega menu across multiple pages?**

A: Yes. You can save the customized section and reuse it across funnels or website pages to maintain consistent navigation.

**Q: Are the mega menu templates mobile responsive?**

A: Yes. The prebuilt mega menu headers are designed to be mobile-friendly and will adjust to smaller screens automatically.

**Q: Can I add my own custom links or buttons?**

A: Absolutely. You can link to internal pages, external URLs, or trigger pop-ups and actions from the mega menu elements.

**Q: Can I change the number of columns in the mega menu?**

A: Yes. You can modify the layout using the visual editor to add or remove columns, change widths, or rearrange content blocks.

**Q: Does the mega menu support dropdown animations?**

A: Yes. Many of the prebuilt designs include built-in dropdown interactions that you can enable or modify during customization.

---

**Next Steps**

    •    Add a mega menu to your homepage to improve top-level navigation.

    •    Customize the design to align with your brand’s visual identity.

    •    Save your customized header as a reusable section for easy replication across your site.

    •    Test on mobile devices to ensure a seamless user experience.

## Overview

The **Contact Engagement Score** trigger is used to add contacts to a workflow based on their engagement score and other criteria, helping you to automate actions based on their interactions and overall engagement level.

## Trigger Name

**Contact Engagement Score**

## Trigger Description

This trigger allows you to filter contacts into a workflow based on their **Engagement Score** and other contact attributes. The trigger helps automate tasks like follow-ups, segmenting highly engaged contacts, or adjusting marketing efforts based on specific criteria.

## Trigger Details

|  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Field Name | Description | Mandatory |
| Score | The engagement score of the contact. Filters are applied based on engagement criteria. | Yes |
| Business Niche | The business category associated with the contact, such as Education, Healthcare, etc. | No |

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033065696/original/RevefXKprkOBwX7qFdxChkT3dIs5xV6SFg.png?1726648831)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Operator | Description |
| Equals to | Triggers if the score or field value equals the input value. |
| Greater than | Triggers if the score or field value is greater than the input value. |
| Greater than or Equal to | Triggers if the score or field value is greater than or equal to the input value. |
| Less than | Triggers if the score or field value is less than the input value. |
| Less than or Equal to | Triggers if the score or field value is less than or equal to the input value. |
| Is empty | Triggers if the field value is empty. |
| Is not empty | Triggers if the field value is not empty. |
| Contains Phrase | Triggers if the field contains the phrase entered. |
| Does not contain Phrase | Triggers if the field does not contain the entered phrase. |

## How to Configure

- **Step 1:** Select the trigger “Contact Engagement Score” from the workflow builder’s trigger options.
- **Step 2:** Give the trigger a name, such as “High Engagement Contacts.”
- **Step 3:**Set the filters to define the engagement score or other criteria.
  - For example, select **Score** from the filter dropdown and choose **Greater than**. Enter a value like **195**.
  - You can add additional filters like **Business Niche** and choose **Contains Phrase**, then enter the niche (e.g., **Education**).
- **Step 4:** Save the trigger configuration and add further actions or steps to your workflow as needed.

## Example

In this scenario, the **Contact Engagement Score** trigger is set to capture contacts with a score **Greater than 195** and in the **Education** niche. When the contact meets both criteria, they will be added to the workflow for a follow-up email campaign.

title_en: How to track leads from an Affiliate Campaign
source_md:
Lead tracking is a crucial aspect of any successful affiliate marketing campaign. By automating the process of tracking leads from forms, surveys, and calendars, you can efficiently manage your affiliates and ensure they are properly rewarded for their efforts. This guide will walk you through the simple steps to start tracking leads within your affiliate campaigns using forms, surveys, and calendars.

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/WY\_KdYwzuhA?&wmode=opaque)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Step-by-Step Guide: Track Leads in Affiliate Campaigns](#Step-by-Step-Guide%3A-Track-Leads-in-Affiliate-Campaigns)
  - [Step 1: Navigate to the Affiliate Campaign Page](#Step-1%3A-Navigate-to-the-Affiliate-Campaign-Page)
  - [Step 2: Click on Add](#Step-2%3A-Click-on-Add)
  - [Step 3: Choose Sources](#Step-3%3A-Choose-Sources)
  - [Step 4: Select Source Details](#Step-4%3A-Select-Source-Details)
  - [Step 5: Review Default Affiliate Campaign URL](#Step-5%3A-Review-Default-Affiliate-Campaign-URL)
  - [Step 6: Enable Pay Per Lead (Optional)](#Step-6%3A-Enable-Pay-Per-Lead-(Optional))
  - [Step 7: Optional Steps](#Step-7%3A-Optional-Steps)
  - [Step 8: Publish the Campaign](#Step-8%3A-Publish-the-Campaign)
  - [Step 9: Track Leads](#Step-9%3A-Track-Leads)
- [Important Notes for Effective Lead Tracking](#Important-Notes-for-Effective-Lead-Tracking)
- [Conclusion: Optimize Your Lead Tracking for Better Campaign Results](#Conclusion%3A-Optimize-Your-Lead-Tracking-for-Better-Campaign-Results)

---

## **Step-by-Step Guide: Track Leads in Affiliate Campaigns**

### **Step 1: Navigate to the Affiliate Campaign Page**

To get started, go to the **Affiliate Manager** under the Marketing tab. From there, click on the **Campaign Page** to manage your campaigns.

### **Step 2: Click on Add**

Once you’re on the Campaign Page, click the **‘Add’** button to create a new campaign for lead tracking.![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033783420/original/OJJxADubEl5Wm2ZheJMKTdXQhASzjw7X2g.jpeg?1727691963)

### **Step 3: Choose Sources**

Select **Forms**, **Surveys**, or **Calendars** as the source for your campaign. These sources allow you to track leads generated through your affiliate's efforts seamlessly.![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033783421/original/HGm1Q1kW6UY5XM4U6AnVuaDetBVjsne1qg.jpeg?1727691963)

### **Step 4: Select Source Details**

Use the dropdown menu to specify the details of your selected source, whether it's a specific form, survey, or calendar you want to track.![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033783419/original/xYJCHZRkvozpHlWIWkBRlcnYP18hSsC5Dg.jpeg?1727691963)

### **Step 5: Review Default Affiliate Campaign URL**

Take a moment to review the **default affiliate campaign URL** generated for your campaign.

```
Please Note: 
If no branded domain is added to the account, the affiliate campaign URL will default to the system domain. Users can add their own branded domain by navigating to Settings > Business Profile > Branded Domain. Once the branded domain is added, all affiliate campaign URLs will automatically update.
```

### **Step 6: Enable Pay Per Lead (Optional)**

If you want to reward your affiliates for every lead they generate, enable the **Pay Per Lead** option in the Commissions tab. For more details on how to enable Pay Per Lead, [learn more here](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003644).

### **Step 7: Optional Steps**

You can further customize the campaign by adding campaign descriptions, assigning affiliates, and adjusting any additional settings as needed.![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033783417/original/ZTRR-lA0FNUA2GYiIXqj6gCJkqdx2A-T2w.jpeg?1727691962)

### **Step 8: Publish the Campaign**

Once you’ve reviewed and finalized all your settings, hit the **‘Publish’** button to make the campaign live.

### **Step 9: Track Leads**

After the campaign goes live, leads will be automatically tracked under each affiliate's profile page. Navigate to the **Leads tab** to view the leads coming from forms, surveys, or calendars. You can use the **Source field** to identify the origin of each lead.![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033783418/original/tScA8p17VPCMhgpVjAROIzSw3l8eKJaxBw.jpeg?1727691963)

---

## **Important Notes for Effective Lead Tracking**

- **Custom Embed/Iframes Are Not Supported:** Lead tracking will only work if forms, surveys, or calendars are added as components inside a funnel or webpage. Ensure these components are properly integrated into the funnel before using it as a source in your affiliate campaign.
- **Branded Domain Requirement:** If you want your affiliate URLs to reflect your branded domain, you must add a branded domain in **Settings > Business Profile > Branded Domain**.

---

## **Conclusion: Optimize Your Lead Tracking for Better Campaign Results**

By following these steps, you’ll be able to seamlessly track leads from forms, surveys, and calendars in your affiliate campaigns. Automating this process not only saves time but also ensures that affiliates are accurately rewarded for their lead-generation efforts. With proper lead tracking in place, you’ll have more control over your affiliate campaigns, leading to better performance and results.

Make sure to implement these best practices in your next campaign and watch how automating lead tracking helps scale your affiliate efforts efficiently!

---

## **What's Next:**

- [How to create an Affiliate Campaign](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003641-how-to-create-an-affiliate-campaign)
- [How to Set Up Multi-Tier Commissions](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003642-how-to-set-up-multi-tier-commissions#Example-1)
- [How to Set Up and Pay Affiliates for Generating Leads](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003644-how-to-set-up-and-pay-affiliates-for-generating-leads)

# 하위 계정에서 왓츠앱 번호 인증 OTP 전송 실패 문제 해결 방법

하위 계정에서 왓츠앱 번호를 인증할 때 OTP(일회용 비밀번호)를 받지 못하는 경우, 이 가이드를 통해 원인을 파악하고 문제를 해결할 수 있습니다.

## 문제 발생 원인

OTP 인증이 실패하는 가장 일반적인 이유는 등록하려는 전화번호가 이미 왓츠앱 비즈니스 앱이나 일반 왓츠앱 메신저에 등록되어 있기 때문입니다. 한 번호는 한 번에 하나의 왓츠앱 플랫폼에서만 활성 상태로 사용할 수 있습니다.

## 번호가 이미 등록되었는지 확인하기

다음 플랫폼에서 해당 전화번호가 현재 활성 상태인지 확인해보세요:

- 왓츠앱 비즈니스 앱
- 일반 왓츠앱 메신저

번호가 이미 등록되어 있다면, 왓츠앱은 온보딩 과정에서 OTP 전송을 차단합니다.

다음은 전화번호가 왓츠앱 비즈니스에 등록되었는지 확인하는 신뢰할 수 있고 실용적인 방법들입니다.

**왓츠앱 공식 Click to Chat 기능 사용**

단계:
- 브라우저를 열어주세요
- 다음 URL을 입력하세요 (국가 코드를 포함한 전체 번호로 교체):

```
https://wa.me/<국가코드><전화번호>
```

예시:
```
https://wa.me/919876543210
```

- Enter를 누르세요

**결과 해석:**
- 왓츠앱이 열리면 → 해당 번호가 왓츠앱에 등록되어 있음 (개인용 또는 비즈니스용)
- "Phone number shared via url is invalid" 메시지가 보이면 → 해당 번호가 왓츠앱에 등록되어 있지 않음

**왓츠앱 비즈니스 앱 내에서 확인**

단계:
- 해당 번호를 휴대폰 연락처에 저장하세요
- 왓츠앱을 열어주세요
- 새 채팅 시작 → 연락처 검색

**확인 지표:**
- 연락처가 나타나면 → 해당 번호가 왓츠앱에 있음
- 연락처가 나타나지 않으면 → 등록되지 않음

**비즈니스 앱 확인 지표:**
- 프로필에 "Business Account" 또는 "Verified Business"가 표시되면, 해당 번호가 왓츠앱 비즈니스에 등록되어 있음
- 비즈니스 계정은 보통 다음을 표시합니다:
  - 비즈니스 이름
  - 비즈니스 카테고리
  - 카탈로그 (선택사항)

## 다음 해결책 중 하나를 선택하세요

### 옵션 1: 다른 전화번호 사용 (권장)

- 왓츠앱에 등록된 적이 없는 새로운 전화번호를 사용하세요.
- 새 번호로 온보딩을 진행하세요.

### 옵션 2: 기존 왓츠앱 계정 삭제

같은 번호를 반드시 사용해야 한다면, 다음 단계를 신중히 따라주세요:

- 같은 번호를 사용하여 모바일 기기에 왓츠앱(비즈니스 또는 일반)을 설치하세요.
- 왓츠앱을 열고 설정(Settings)으로 이동하세요.
- 계정(Account) → 계정 삭제(Delete Account)를 선택하세요.
- 모바일 기기에서 왓츠앱 계정 삭제를 확인하세요.
- 몇 분 기다린 후, 하위 계정에서 온보딩과 OTP 인증을 다시 시도하세요.

⚠️ 왓츠앱 계정을 삭제하면 해당 번호와 연결된 채팅 기록과 데이터가 영구적으로 제거됩니다.

## 여전히 OTP를 받지 못하나요?

전화번호가:
- 왓츠앱이나 왓츠앱 비즈니스에 등록되어 있지 않고
- 여전히 OTP를 받을 수 없는 경우

다음 정보와 함께 지원 티켓을 제출해주세요:

- 전화번호 (국가 코드 포함)
- 하위 계정 ID
- OTP 인증 중 표시된 스크린샷 또는 정확한 오류 메시지
- OTP 시도가 실패한 대략적인 시간
